prompt: If the centre (to open) early, I will walk the older dogs.
explanation_ru: После if в условном придаточном ставится Present Simple, даже когда речь о будущем, поэтому opens.

prompt: If you come to the class, I (to keep) the room open later.
explanation_ru: Это первое условное: в главной части выражаем будущее с помощью will keep.

prompt: Will I get the sea-view room if a guest (to check) out? If nobody does, you (to wait) in the garden room.
explanation_ru: В вопросе условие после if остаётся в Present Simple (checks), а результат в главной части — will wait.

prompt: I can (to finish) the report on time if you (to take) one small task.
explanation_ru: После модального can идёт инфинитив без to (finish), а после if — Present Simple (take).

prompt: Billie (to plant) the flowers by the fence if the neighbours (to agree).
explanation_ru: Результат — will plant, условие после if — Present Simple (agree).

prompt: If I (to be) late, please (to hold) the book for me.
explanation_ru: После if нужен Present Simple (am); во второй части — повелительное наклонение hold.

prompt: My son (not / to bring) the homework on Monday if you (not / to allow) it.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное первое условное: в главной части will not (won't bring), после if — Present Simple (don't allow).

prompt: Look at my dress. It is too long for the show. — Don't worry. If you (to give) it to me, I (to fix) it.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (give), результат — will fix.

prompt: I want the party outside, but the weather is not sure. If it (to rain), please (to move) the tables inside. If it (to stay) dry, we (to have) it in the garden. Do not tell my sister.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (rains, stays); после please — инфинитив без to (move); результат — will have.

prompt: I am helping at the old site, but our money is running out. If the money (to come), we (to continue) the work. If we (not / to get) it, we will stop. I will call you when we (to hear) the news.
explanation_ru: После if и when — Present Simple (comes, do not get, hear); результат — will continue.

prompt: The soup class is free. If the centre (to give) me the pots, I (to teach) it. Please come.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple (gives), результат — will teach.

prompt: The new floodlights are still not ready, so the evening classes cannot begin. If the builders (to finish) them in time, Rohan (to start) the course and (to put) up a notice. When the lights (to work), everyone can train. If not, we will wait.
explanation_ru: После if и when — Present Simple (finish, work); в главной части — will start и will put.

prompt: The office will give you a new ticket if you ___ it.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя употреблять will; нужен Present Simple — lose.

prompt: If my flat owner ___ the papers, I will bring the second cat home.
explanation_ru: После if ставим Present Simple, а для he/she/it добавляем -s: signs.

prompt: If Rosa ___ the bigger place, she will open a second shop.
explanation_ru: После if нужен Present Simple, и для Rosa — форма gets.

prompt: Ada will book a ticket when her friend ___ yes.
explanation_ru: После when в придаточном времени ставится Present Simple: says, а не will say.

prompt: If Priyanka rests before the match, she ___ better.
explanation_ru: Это результат в главной части, поэтому нужен will play, а не настоящее время.

prompt: Gül will watch it if you will make a video.
answer: Gül will watch it if you make a video.
accepted_answers: Gül will watch it if you make a video.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — will после if; правильно: if you make a video.

prompt: Yuki will attend when you will give her a new time.
answer: Yuki will attend when you give her a new time.
accepted_answers: Yuki will attend when you give her a new time.
explanation_ru: После when в придаточном условия will не ставится: правильно when you give.

prompt: If Chloe's train does not arrive on time, she will miss the check-in.
answer: If Chloe's train does not arrive on time, she will miss the check-in.
accepted_answers: If Chloe's train does not arrive on time, she will miss the check-in.
If Chloe's train does not arrive on time, she'll miss the check-in.
If Chloe's train doesn't arrive on time, she will miss the check-in.
If Chloe's train doesn't arrive on time, she'll miss the check-in.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после if — Present Simple (does not arrive), в главной части — will miss.

prompt: Serena needs tables for the party. She asks her neighbour for help. Which sentence fits?
options: If the neighbour says yes, Serena will borrow the tables.
If the neighbour will say yes, Serena borrows the tables.
If the neighbour said yes, Serena would borrow the tables.
If the neighbour says yes, Serena borrowed the tables.
explanation_ru: Верное первое условное: If + Present Simple (says), will + инфинитив (will borrow).

prompt: Tiago must change his clinic session. He asks for a Friday slot. Which sentence fits?
options: If the clinic will have a free slot, Tiago takes it.
If the clinic had a free slot, Tiago will take it.
If the clinic has a free slot, Tiago will take it.
If the clinic has a free slot, Tiago would take it.
explanation_ru: Правильный вариант — первое условное: if + Present Simple, will + инфинитив.

prompt: Ji-eun will repaint the children's room when the shop delivers the colour she chose. → If the shop delivers the colour, …
answer: If the shop delivers the colour, Ji-eun will repaint the children's room.
accepted_answers: If the shop delivers the colour, Ji-eun will repaint the children's room.
If the shop delivers the colour, Ji-eun is going to repaint the children's room.
If the shop delivers the colour, she will repaint the children's room.
If the shop delivers the colour, she is going to repaint the children's room.
explanation_ru: When (уверенность) меняем на If (возможность); в if-части Present Simple, в главной — will или be going to.

prompt: Selma will get her laptop back when the part arrives. → If the part does not arrive, …
answer: If the part does not arrive, Selma will not get her laptop back.
accepted_answers: If the part does not arrive, Selma will not get her laptop back.
If the part does not arrive, Selma won't get her laptop back.
If the part does not arrive, she will not get her laptop back.
If the part does not arrive, she won't get her laptop back.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple в отрицании (does not arrive), результат — will not.

prompt: Match the halves.
pairs: If the rain does not come,
we cut it and sell it.
explanation_ru: Первое условное использует will, модальный глагол или повелительное наклонение; нулевое (when + Present Simple) описывает общее правило.

prompt: Join the halves.
pairs: we will open the Roman room.
If the cases do not arrive,
we will keep the room closed.
If a visitor asks a question,
I can show them the map.
explanation_ru: После if — Present Simple и will/modal; после when — Present Simple для обычного действия.

prompt: Which group does each sentence belong to?

items.text: If the owner calls, we will give the bicycle back.
We will keep it by the gate if nobody comes.
If it rains, I will move the bicycle inside.
If a bicycle stays outside, it gets wet.
People feel happy if they get a lost thing back.
If you find a lost bike, you tell the police.

explanation_ru: Первое условное — возможное будущее (will + инфинитив); нулевое — общая истина (Present Simple в обеих частях).

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: If you give us a second date, we will come.
accepted_answers: If you give us a second date, we will come.
explanation_ru: Собираем первое условное: If + Present Simple, затем will + инфинитив; возможен и обратный порядок частей.
